name: package:export
description: Export the tenant as a package archive and download stored package archives

name: package:import
description: Preview, apply and list package imports into this tenant

name: connector:promote
description: Promote a connector and its credentials from DEV to PROD

name: connector:confirm_local_command
description: Confirm the local command a stdio MCP connector starts on the engine host

name: vault:read
description: Read vault item metadata, never values

name: vault:write
description: Create vault items or change their description

name: vault:rotate
description: Replace the value of a vault item

name: vault:reveal
description: Reveal the value of a workspace vault item

name: skill:propose
description: Propose a skill candidate (learning) for human review

name: execution:signal
description: POST a wait-for-event signal to a paused execution (e.g. an HITL approval). The signals route also accepts a one-shot HMAC token; this permission gates the bearer-auth path.

name: task:read
description: Read tasks, their standing permissions and the preview of what a permission would allow

name: task:run
description: Start a task run and confirm its result

name: task:grant
description: Grant or revoke the standing permission that lets a task run on its own

name: device:read
description: List your own desktop devices, their state and their local allowances

name: device:manage
description: Enroll your own desktop device for local steps, mirror its allowances and revoke it

name: device:revoke_any
description: Revoke any person's desktop device in this workspace

name: local:confirm
description: Confirm or decline a committing local action of a run you may start

name: identity:write
description: Create or update tenant identity rows

name: metrics:read
description: Scrape the engine-wide Prometheus metrics (engine operator only)

name: stats:read
description: Read tenant-scoped runtime statistics: workflow runs, connector calls, audit-class events, LLM usage

name: stats:read:all
description: Read other users' LLM usage and cross-user breakdowns within the tenant

name: self_healing:read
description: Read tenant-scoped proactive drift scan history

name: rbac:read
description: Read RBAC roles, permissions, grants, groups

name: rbac:write
description: Manage RBAC roles, permissions, grants, groups

name: conversation:read
description: Read conversation messages, history, tool-call results

name: conversation:write
description: Create conversation, append messages, drive turns

name: memory:write
description: Attach a user-supplied memory payload to a conversation turn

name: mcp:read
description: List MCP prompts, resources, and tools for slash-command pickers

name: mcp:authoring
description: Access the MCP endpoint with conversation authoring tools enabled

name: mcp:admin
description: Access the MCP endpoint with full tenant admin tools enabled

name: mcp_external_tool:invoke
description: Invoke a tool exposed by a registered external MCP server

name: knowledge:read
description: Read knowledge sources and search knowledge

name: knowledge:write
description: Create, update, or refresh knowledge sources

name: intake:read
description: Read collected clips, intake collections, and knowledge proposals

name: intake:write
description: Collect and organize clips, intake collections, and knowledge proposals

name: intake:confirm
description: Confirm a reviewed knowledge proposal for publication

name: discovery:write
description: Create discovery runs and upload files for analysis

name: settings:read
description: Read your own tenant's settings (secrets are masked in the response)

name: settings:read:global
description: Read engine-wide settings, revisions, secrets, diagnostics and every tenant's settings (engine operator only)

name: settings:write:global
description: Change and activate engine-wide settings, secrets and any tenant's settings (engine operator only)

name: system:restart
description: Restart the engine so a saved restart-sensitive setting takes effect (engine operator only; needs a supervisor)

name: file:read
description: Read file metadata and download file content

name: connection:read
description: List outbound connections (Cockpit: Credentials) and their state

name: connection:write
description: Connect to, renew and disconnect outbound connections

name: mcp_oauth_client:revoke
description: Revoke a registered MCP OAuth client's grants and tokens in your own tenant

name: mcp_oauth_client:disable
description: Disable a registered MCP OAuth client for the whole engine and revoke its tokens in every tenant (engine operator only)

name: chat_workspace:read
description: List chat workspaces installed in this tenant

name: chat_workspace:write
description: Install or remove a chat workspace (Slack/Teams/Google Chat)

name: chat_identity:read
description: List chat-identity links (platform user → subkit user)

name: chat_identity:write
description: Link or unlink a chat user to a subkit user
